title: 2011 年全国硕士研究生招生考试 英语（二）

sections.title: Section I　完形填空
sections.dir: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：匿名带来网络犯罪，施密特提出“自愿可信身份”方案，正反两派各执一词。第 13 空靠全文关键词 trusted 复现定案。

paras.en: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech. But that very anonymity is also behind the explosion of cyber-crime that has 1 across the Web.
paras.zh: 互联网给予用户匿名性，这对隐私和言论自由来说是件好事。但正是这种匿名性，也是席卷整个网络的网络犯罪狂潮背后的原因。

paras.en: Can privacy be preserved 2 bringing safety and security to a world that seems increasingly 3 ?
paras.zh: 在为这个似乎越来越 3 的世界 2 带来安全保障的同时，隐私还能保得住吗？

paras.en: Last month, Howard Schmidt, the nation's cyber-czar, offered the federal government a 4 to make the Web a safer place - a "voluntary trusted identity" system that would be the high-tech 5 of a physical key, a fingerprint and a photo ID card, all rolled 6 one. The system might use a smart identity card, or a digital credential 7 to a specific computer, and would authenticate users at a range of online services.
paras.zh: 上个月，美国网络安全主管霍华德·施密特（Howard Schmidt）向联邦政府提出了一个 4，要让网络变得更安全——一个“自愿可信身份”系统，它相当于把实体钥匙、指纹和带照片的身份证三者 6 一体的高科技 5。该系统可能使用智能身份证，或与某台特定电脑 7 的数字凭证，并会在一系列在线服务中对用户进行身份验证。

paras.en: The idea is to 8 a federation of private online identity systems. Users could 9 which system to join, and only registered users whose identities have been authenticated could navigate those systems. The approach contrasts with one that would require an Internet driver's license 10 by the government.
paras.zh: 这一构想是要 8 一个由私营在线身份系统组成的联盟。用户可以 9 加入哪个系统，只有身份经过验证的注册用户才能进入这些系统。这种做法与要求由政府 10 一张“互联网驾照”的思路形成对照。

paras.en: Google and Microsoft are among companies that already have these "single sign on" systems that make it possible for users to 11 just once but use many different services.
paras.zh: 谷歌和微软等公司已经拥有这种“单点登录”系统，使用户可以 11 一次却使用多种不同的服务。

paras.en: 12 , the approach would create a "walled garden" in cyberspace, with safe "neighborhoods" and bright "streetlights" to establish a sense of a 13 community.
paras.zh: 12，这种做法会在网络空间造出一个“围墙花园”，其中有安全的“街区”和明亮的“路灯”，以营造出一种 13 社区的感觉。

paras.en: Mr. Schmidt described it as a "voluntary ecosystem" in which "individuals and organizations can complete online transactions with 14 , trusting the identities of each other and the identities of the infrastructure 15 which the transaction runs."
paras.zh: 施密特先生称其为一个“自愿生态系统”：在这个系统中，“个人和组织可以 14 地完成在线交易，信任彼此的身份，也信任交易所 15 的基础设施的身份”。

paras.en: Still, the administration's plan has 16 privacy rights activists. Some applaud the approach; others are concerned. It seems clear that such a scheme is an initiative push toward what would 17 be a compulsory Internet "driver's license" mentality.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，政府这一计划还是在隐私权活动人士中 16 了分歧。一些人为之叫好，另一些人则忧心忡忡。显然，这样的方案是在主动推动一种 17 会变成强制性“互联网驾照”的心态。

paras.en: The plan has also been greeted with 18 by some computer security experts, who worry that the "voluntary ecosystem" envisioned by Mr. Schmidt would still leave much of the Internet 19 . They argue that all Internet users should be 20 to register and identify themselves, in the same way that drivers must be licensed to drive on public roads.
paras.zh: 该计划也遭到一些计算机安全专家的 18，他们担心施密特先生所设想的那种“自愿生态系统”仍会让互联网的大部分 19。他们主张，所有互联网用户都应被 20 登记并表明身份，就像司机必须取得驾照才能在公路上开车一样。

items.exp: 定位首段末句 the explosion of cyber-crime that has 1 across the Web。主语是“网络犯罪的爆炸式增长”，sweep across 意为“席卷、蔓延至整个网络”，与 across 的覆盖义吻合。skipped 指“跳过”，与“遍布全网”相反；walked、ridden 都无法与“犯罪激增”这一主语搭配。
定位第二段整句 Can privacy be preserved 2 bringing safety and security...。主句是疑问“隐私还保得住吗”，bringing 部分是同时发生的情况，while 引导伴随/对比状语，意为“在带来安全的同时”。for 表目的，会读成“为了带来安全”，把安全说成了目的；though 表让步，与疑问语气不合。
定位第二段末 a world that seems increasingly 3。上一段刚说网络犯罪席卷全网，故这个世界显得越来越“无法无天”，laws 与 lawless 的否定式正好承接 cyber-crime。careless 指“粗心”，pointless 指“无意义”，helpless 指“无助”，都无法概括犯罪泛滥。

定位第三段首句 offered the federal government a 4 to make the Web a safer place。破折号后的同位语 a voluntary trusted identity system 就是这份“提议”的具体内容，offer sb a proposal 也合搭配。reason 后不接 to make 表“方案”；reminder 指“提醒”，compromise 指“妥协”，都与“提出一个系统”不符。
定位第三段 the high-tech 5 of a physical key, a fingerprint and a photo ID card。这里要说这套系统是钥匙、指纹、身份证的“高科技对等物”，the equivalent of 为固定表达。information、interference、entertainment 与 of 连用都不表“对等物”，句意也不通。
定位同句 all rolled 6 one。roll sth into one 是固定搭配，意为“把……合为一体”，与前文列举的钥匙、指纹、身份证三项对应。by 表方式、from 表来源、over 表覆盖，与 roll 搭配都得不到“合并成一”的意思。
定位第三段末 a digital credential 7 to a specific computer。数字凭证与某台电脑是“绑定”关系，be linked to 正确。directed to 表“指向”，chained to 是“用链子拴住”，含贬义且过于具象，compared to 是“比作”，都不能说明凭证的归属关系。

定位第四段首句 The idea is to 8 a federation of private online identity systems。后文 Users could select which system to join 说明这个联盟此前并不存在，要从无到有地“建立”，create 正确。dismiss（解散）方向相反，discover（发现）指找到已有之物，improve（改进）预设了已有基础。
定位第四段 Users could 9 which system to join。空格后是 which system to join（加入哪个系统），只能填“挑选”之义的 select。recall（回忆起）、suggest（建议）、realize（意识到）都不能带 which...to join 这一宾语，也无法与 join 形成“选择加入”的逻辑。
定位第四段末 an Internet driver's license 10 by the government。驾照与政府是“签发”关系，issue 的过去分词作后置定语，issue a license 为固定搭配。released 指“释放、发布”，distributed 指“分发”，delivered 指“投递”，都不用于证件签发。

定位第五段 these single sign on systems that make it possible for users to 11 just once but use many different services。破折号前的 single sign on（单点登录）已给出提示，“登录一次、使用多项服务”正是 log in。carry on（继续）、linger on（逗留）、set in（开始、来临）都与登录无关。
定位第六段 12 , the approach would create a walled garden in cyberspace。上一段讲单点登录的现状，此处转为说明这套方案“实际上”会造成什么效果，In effect 正合。In vain（徒劳）含失败义，In return（作为回报）需有交换对象，In contrast 后文并无对比的另一方。
定位第六段 to establish a sense of a 13 community。本段核心词是上一段的 trusted identity，安全的“街区”与明亮的“路灯”都是为了营造“可信任的社区”感，trusted 属关键词复现。modernized、thriving、competing 都离开了“可信身份”这条主线，thriving 还与“围墙花园”的封闭意象不搭。

定位第七段 complete online transactions with 14 , trusting the identities of each other。现在分词 trusting 是对空格的具体说明——因为互相信任身份，才能“放心地”交易，with confidence 正确。caution（谨慎）与 trusting 直接矛盾，delight（欣喜）、patience（耐心）与交易安全无关。

定位第七段 the identities of the infrastructure 15 which the transaction runs。定语从句还原为 the transaction runs on the infrastructure，介词 on 提前，故填 on。after、beyond、across 与 run 搭配分别表“在……之后运行”“超出”“横穿”，都不能表示“在……之上运行”。

定位第八段 the administration's plan has 16 privacy rights activists。紧接着的 Some applaud the approach; others are concerned 说明活动人士被分成两派，divide 正确。united（使团结）与后文自相矛盾，protected（保护）与“有人叫好有人担忧”无关，disappointed 只覆盖了反对的一半。

定位第八段末 what would 17 be a compulsory Internet driver's license mentality。作者预言这套“自愿”方案最终会滑向强制驾照式管理，eventually 表“最终、到头来”，与 initiative push toward 的递进语气一致。frequently、occasionally 说的是频次，incidentally 是“顺便一提”，都不能表达这种必然趋势。
定位第九段 greeted with 18 by some computer security experts, who worry that...。who worry that 直接解释了这种态度是“怀疑”，skepticism 正确。tolerance（容忍）与 indifference（漠不关心）都与“担心”相悖，专家并非无所谓；enthusiasm（热情）更是与 worry 完全相反。
定位第九段 would still leave much of the Internet 19。专家担心自愿机制覆盖不全，网络的大部分仍“易受攻击”，vulnerable 正确，也与上文 cyber-crime 呼应。manageable（易管理）、defendable（可辩护）恰是专家认为做不到的状态，invisible（看不见）与安全议题无关。

定位末句 all Internet users should be 20 to register...in the same way that drivers must be licensed。must be licensed 说明主张的是“强制”注册，be forced to 正确。invited（邀请）、allowed（允许）语气太软，appointed（任命）与 register 不搭配，三者都与 must 的强制意味冲突。

sections.title: Text 1　外部董事为何提前抽身
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：外部董事常在坏消息爆出前离场，以保住声誉。第 23 题“股票表现更差”≠“重述盈利上升”，别被 earnings 骗。

paras.en: Ruth Simmons joined Goldman Sachs's board as an outside director in January 2000; a year later she became president of Brown University. For the rest of the decade she apparently managed both roles without attracting much criticism. But by the end of 2009 Ms. Simmons was under fire for having sat on Goldman's compensation committee; how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked? By February the next year Ms. Simmons had left the board. The position was just taking up too much time, she said.
paras.zh: 露丝·西蒙斯（Ruth Simmons）2000 年 1 月以外部董事身份加入高盛董事会；一年后她出任布朗大学校长。此后近十年，她显然同时扮演好这两个角色，没有招致多少批评。但到 2009 年底，西蒙斯女士因曾任职于高盛的薪酬委员会而饱受指责：她怎么能对那些巨额奖金发放不置一词？到次年 2 月，西蒙斯女士已离开董事会。她说，这个职位实在太占时间了。

paras.en: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers on a firm's board. Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals. If the sky, and the share price, is falling, outside directors should be able to give advice based on having weathered their own crises.
paras.zh: 外部董事本应在公司董事会中充当有帮助而偏见较少的顾问。他们的财富和声望是在别处挣得的，因而理应有足够的独立性去反对首席执行官的建议。即便天塌下来、股价正在下跌，外部董事也应能依据自己渡过危机的经验提出建议。

paras.en: The researchers from Ohio University used a database that covered more than 10,000 firms and more than 64,000 different directors between 1989 and 2004. Then they simply checked which directors stayed from one proxy statement to the next. The most likely reason for departing a board was age, so the researchers concentrated on those "surprise" disappearances by directors under the age of 70. They found that after a surprise departure, the probability that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings increases by nearly 20%. The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse. The effect tended to be larger for larger firms. Although a correlation between them leaving and subsequent bad performance at the firm is suggestive, it does not mean that such directors are always jumping off a sinking ship. Often they "trade up," leaving riskier, smaller firms for larger and more stable firms.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄大学的研究人员使用了一个覆盖 1989 至 2004 年间一万多家公司、六万四千多名董事的数据库。然后他们只需查清哪些董事在相邻两份委托书之间留任。离开董事会最常见的原因是年龄，因此研究者把注意力集中在 70 岁以下董事那些“意外”消失上。他们发现，在一次意外离职之后，公司随后被迫重述盈利的概率上升近 20%；被列入联邦集体诉讼的可能性也会上升，股票也往往表现更差。这种效应在大公司往往更大。尽管董事离职与公司随后业绩不佳之间的相关性耐人寻味，但这并不意味着这些董事总是在“弃船逃生”。他们常常是“往上跳”，离开风险更大的小公司，去更大、更稳定的公司。

paras.en: But the researchers believe that outside directors have an easier time of avoiding a blow to their reputations if they leave a firm before bad news breaks, even if a review of history shows they were on the board at the time any wrongdoing occurred. Firms who want to keep their outside directors through tough times may have to create incentives. Otherwise outside directors will follow the example of Ms. Simmons, once again very popular on campus.
paras.zh: 但研究者认为，如果外部董事在坏消息爆出之前离开公司，他们就更容易避免声誉受损，即便回顾历史可以发现，公司发生不当行为时他们仍在董事会任职。想在艰难时期留住外部董事的公司，可能必须拿出激励措施。否则外部董事就会效仿西蒙斯女士——如今她在校园里又大受欢迎了。

items.stem: According to Paragraph 1, Ms. Simmons was criticized for
opts: leaving the board in tough times
items.exp: 定位第一段③句 was under fire for having sat on Goldman's compensation committee; how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked? 她身为薪酬委员会委员却任由巨额奖金过关，属“未尽责”，B 正确。A 把“她没拦下的奖金”说成“她自己获利”；D 是她离职这一结果，不是被批评的原因。

items.stem: We learn from Paragraph 2 that outside directors are supposed to be
items.exp: 定位第二段①②句 serve as helpful, yet less biased, advisers 与 have enough independence to disagree。advisers 加 independence 即 independent advisers，D 正确。B 的 executives 错在外部董事不是高管；C 把 give advice 窄化成“预测股价”；A 的 investor 文中无据。

items.stem: According to the researchers from Ohio University, after an outside director's surprise departure, the firm is likely to
opts: do less well in the stock market
items.exp: 定位第三段⑥句 the stock is likely to perform worse，即离职后公司股票在市场上表现更差，C 正确。B 把 the probability that the company will subsequently have to restate earnings increases by nearly 20% 曲解为“盈利增长”，实为“被迫重述财报的概率上升”；D 把“被列入集体诉讼的可能性上升”换成“在诉讼中表现更差”。

items.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that outside directors
opts: may stay for the attractive offers from the firm
have often had records of wrongdoings in the firm
are accustomed to stress-free work in the firm
will decline incentives from the firm
items.exp: 定位末段②句 Firms who want to keep their outside directors through tough times may have to create incentives，即要靠有吸引力的条件留人，A 正确。B 把“在位期间公司出过事”偷换成“本人有违规记录”；D 与 create incentives 的目的相反。

items.stem: The author's attitude toward the role of outside directors is
items.exp: 定位第二段 helpful, yet less biased, advisers 与末段“公司应设法留住他们”，作者把外部董事视为董事会中值得肯定的制衡力量，B 正确。D 的 critical 针对的是“出事前抽身”这一具体行为，不是对该角色的整体评价；C 的 scornful 文中毫无贬斥语气。

sections.title: Text 2　报业的自救与转机
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：报业没死，靠裁员、涨价、砍边角业务重回盈利。第 28 题盯住 87% 与 35% 这个广告依赖差。

paras.en: Whatever happened to the death of newspapers? A year ago the end seemed near. The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet. Newspapers like the San Francisco Chronicle were chronicling their own doom. America's Federal Trade Commission launched a round of talks about how to save newspapers. Should they become charitable corporations? Should the state subsidize them? It will hold another meeting soon. But the discussions now seem out of date.
paras.zh: “报纸之死”到底怎么了？一年前，终结似乎近在眼前。衰退有可能夺走那些尚未逃向互联网的广告和读者。《旧金山纪事报》这样的报纸正在记录自己的末日。美国联邦贸易委员会发起了一轮会谈，讨论如何拯救报纸：它们是否该变成慈善机构？国家是否该补贴它们？该委员会很快还将再开一次会。但如今这些讨论似乎已经过时。

paras.en: In much of the world there is little sign of crisis. German and Brazilian papers have shrugged off the recession. Even American newspapers, which inhabit the most troubled corner of the global industry, have not only survived but often returned to profit. Not the 20% profit margins that were routine a few years ago, but profit all the same.
paras.zh: 在世界大部分地区，几乎看不到危机的迹象。德国和巴西的报纸对衰退不以为意。就连身处全球报业最困境地的美国报纸，也不仅活了下来，而且常常重新盈利。虽然不再是几年前司空见惯的 20% 利润率，但毕竟还是盈利。

paras.en: It has not been much fun. Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard. The American Society of News Editors reckons that 13,500 newsroom jobs have gone since 2007. Readers are paying more for slimmer products. Some papers even had the nerve to refuse delivery to distant suburbs. Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones and, sadly for many journalists, they can be pushed further.
paras.zh: 日子并不好过。许多报纸是靠把记者赶下船才得以维持的。美国新闻编辑协会估计，自 2007 年以来已有 13500 个编辑岗位消失。读者花更多的钱，买到的却是更薄的报纸。有些报纸甚至有胆量拒绝向远郊投递。然而这些孤注一掷的措施被证明是对的，而且——对许多记者来说很不幸——还可以继续推下去。

paras.en: Newspapers are becoming more balanced businesses, with a healthier mix of revenues from readers and advertisers. American papers have long been highly unusual in their reliance on ads. Fully 87% of their revenues came from advertising in 2008, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation & Development (OECD). In Japan the proportion is 35%. Not surprisingly, Japanese newspapers are much more stable.
paras.zh: 报纸正在变成更均衡的生意，来自读者和广告主的收入结构更健康。美国报纸长期以来在依赖广告方面极为特殊。根据经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的数据，2008 年其收入的整整 87% 来自广告。在日本，这一比例是 35%。难怪日本报纸要稳定得多。

paras.en: The whirlwind that swept through newsrooms harmed everybody, but much of the damage has been concentrated in areas where newspapers are least distinctive. Car and film reviewers have gone. So have science and general business reporters. Foreign bureaus have been savagely cut off. Newspapers are less complete as a result. But completeness is no longer a virtue in the newspaper business.
paras.zh: 席卷编辑部的这场旋风伤害了所有人，但大部分损失集中在报纸最没有特色的领域。汽车和电影评论员走了，科学记者和普通商业记者也走了，驻外分社被大幅砍掉。报纸因此变得不那么完整。但在报业，完整性已不再是一种优点。

items.stem: By saying "Newspapers like ... their own doom" (Lines 3-4, Para. 1), the author indicates that newspapers
items.exp: 定位第一段④句 Newspapers like the San Francisco Chronicle were chronicling their own doom。“记录自己的末日”是比喻性说法，紧接 the end seemed near，说明报业当时处境危急，D 正确。A 与“末日将近”的判断相反；B、C 是 FTC 讨论的两个备选方案，与这句话无关。

items.stem: Some newspapers refused delivery to distant suburbs probably because
opts: journalists reported little about these areas
items.exp: 定位第三段：裁员、让读者为更薄的报纸多付钱、拒送远郊，三个动作同属一组削减成本的措施，故 B 正确。A 与 Readers are paying more 相反；C 把“远郊”误解为报道盲区；D 是读者对报纸变薄的反应，不是报社拒送的原因。

items.stem: Compared with their American counterparts, Japanese newspapers are much more stable because they
items.exp: 定位第四段：美国报纸 87% 的收入来自广告，日本只有 35%，随后一句说日本报纸更稳定，可见原因是广告依赖度低，C 正确。A 的“收入来源更多”说得含糊，日本靠的是发行与广告的均衡；B 把 balanced businesses 偷换成 balanced newsrooms，主体错位。

items.stem: What can be inferred from the last paragraph about the current newspaper business?
opts: Distinctiveness is an essential feature of newspapers.
Completeness is to blame for the failure of newspaper.
Foreign bureaus play a crucial role in the newspaper business.
Readers have lost their interest in car and film reviews.
items.exp: 定位末段：被砍掉的都是 newspapers are least distinctive 的领域，末句又说 completeness is no longer a virtue，言下之意是“不可替代”才是报纸立足之本，A 正确。B 把“完整性不再是优点”推成“完整性导致失败”，属过度归因；D 把“评论员被裁”说成“读者失去兴趣”，因果颠倒。

items.stem: The most appropriate title for this text would be
opts: American Newspapers: Gone with the Wind
items.exp: 全文脉络：首段设问“报纸之死怎么了”，二段说危机迹象消退、美国报纸重返盈利，三段写裁员涨价的求生手段，四段写收入结构变健康，末段说“不完整”也能活，主线是挣扎求生，A 正确。C 的 thriving 与裁员 13500 人矛盾，B、D 与 returned to profit 相反。

sections.title: Text 3　“少即是多”与战后美国住宅
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：“少即是多”如何变成战后美国住宅风尚。第 34 题 materials 那句是“今天平常、当年象征未来”，别读成当时流行。

paras.en: We tend to think of the decades immediately following World War II as a time of prosperity and growth, with soldiers returning home by the millions, going off to college on the G. I. Bill and lining up at the marriage bureaus.
paras.zh: 我们往往把二战刚结束的几十年看作繁荣与增长的时期：数以百万计的士兵返乡，凭《退伍军人权利法案》上大学，在婚姻登记处排起长队。

paras.en: But when it came to their houses, it was a time of common sense and a belief that less could truly be more. During the Depression and the war, Americans had learned to live with less, and that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish.
paras.zh: 但说到住房，那是一个讲究常识、相信“少确实可以多”的年代。在大萧条和战争期间，美国人学会了将就着过日子，而这种节制，加上战后对未来的信心，使小而高效的住宅成了十足的时髦。

paras.en: Economic condition was only a stimulus for the trend toward efficient living. The phrase "less is more" was actually first popularized by a German, the architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe, who like other people associated with the Bauhaus, a school of design, emigrated to the United States before World War II and took up posts at American architecture schools. These designers came to exert enormous influence on the course of American architecture, but none more so than Mies.
paras.zh: 经济状况只是这股高效居住潮流的一个促因。“少即是多”这句话其实最早是由一位德国人推广开来的，即建筑师路德维希·密斯·凡·德·罗（Ludwig Mies van der Rohe）。他像其他与设计学校包豪斯有关的人一样，在二战前移居美国，并在美国多所建筑院校任职。这些设计师对美国建筑的发展历程产生了巨大影响，而其中影响最大的莫过于密斯。

paras.en: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot. Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance. Like other modern architects, he employed metal, glass and laminated wood — materials that we take for granted today but that in the 1940s symbolized the future. Mies's sophisticated presentation masked the fact that the spaces he designed were small and efficient, rather than big and often empty.
paras.zh: 密斯的这句标志性话语的意思是：装饰更少，只要组织得当，效果胜过繁复。他相信，优雅并不来自堆砌。与其他现代建筑师一样，他使用金属、玻璃和胶合木——这些材料今天我们习以为常，但在 20 世纪 40 年代却是未来的象征。密斯精致的呈现方式掩盖了一个事实：他设计的空间小而高效，而不是大而常常空旷。

paras.en: The apartments in the elegant towers Mies built on Chicago's Lake Shore Drive, for example, were smaller — two-bedroom units under 1,000 square feet — than those in their older neighbors along the city's Gold Coast. But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
paras.zh: 例如，密斯在芝加哥湖滨大道建造的那些优雅高层公寓，就比黄金海岸一带更老的邻座建筑要小——两居室单元不到 1000 平方英尺。但它们很受欢迎，因为有通透的玻璃墙、开阔的视野，以及建筑细部和比例的优雅——那正是当时风行的抽象艺术在建筑上的对等物。

paras.en: The trend toward "less" was not entirely foreign. In the 1930s Frank Lloyd Wright started building more modest and efficient houses — usually around 1,200 square feet — than the spreading two-story ones he had designed in the 1890s and the early 20th century.
paras.zh: “少”的潮流并非全然舶来。20 世纪 30 年代，弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特（Frank Lloyd Wright）开始建造更为朴素、高效的住宅——通常在 1200 平方英尺左右——比他 19 世纪 90 年代和 20 世纪初设计的那些不断铺开的两层住宅要小。

paras.en: The "Case Study Houses" commissioned from talented modern architects by California Arts & Architecture magazine between 1945 and 1962 were yet another homegrown influence on the "less is more" trend. Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing. In his Case Study House, Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted just how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life — few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers — but his belief that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable was widely shared.
paras.zh: 1945 至 1962 年间，加州《艺术与建筑》杂志委托才华出众的现代建筑师建造的“案例研究住宅”，是推动“少即是多”潮流的又一股本土力量。美学效果来自景观、新材料和直白的细部处理。在自己的案例研究住宅中，拉尔夫·拉普森（Ralph Rapson）也许误判了机械革命将如何影响日常生活——很少有美国家庭拥有直升机，尽管大多数最终都有了干衣机——但他认为自给自足既值得追求又不可避免，这一信念得到了广泛认同。

items.stem: The postwar American housing style largely reflected the Americans'
items.exp: 定位第二段末句 that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish。题干问这种风格由什么观念造成，正是 restraint 与 confidence 两项，C 正确。A 是首段对战后年代的整体描述，不是住宅成因；B 的 efficiency 是住宅自身特征。

items.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3 about the Bauhaus?
opts: It was founded by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe.
Its designing concept was affected by World War II.
Most American architects used to be associated with it.
It had a great influence upon American architecture.
items.exp: 定位第三段末句 These designers came to exert enormous influence on the course of American architecture。these designers 即前句“与包豪斯有关的那些人”，说明包豪斯一脉对美国建筑影响巨大，D 正确。A 把“与包豪斯有关”说成“创建包豪斯”；B 把“二战前移居美国”改成“理念受二战影响”；C 的 most 无据。

items.stem: Mies held that elegance of architectural design
opts: was not reliant on abundant decoration
items.exp: 定位第四段①②句 less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot 与 Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance，即优雅不靠繁复装饰堆出来，C 正确。A 与“他设计的空间小而高效”相反；B 把 rather than big and often empty 中的 empty 误当成他推崇的目标；D 与 efficient 直接冲突。

items.stem: What is true about the apartments Mies built on Chicago's Lake Shore Drive?
opts: They were built with materials popular at that time.
They were more spacious than neighboring buildings.
They shared some characteristics of abstract art.
items.exp: 定位第五段末句 the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time，即这些公寓具备当时抽象艺术的特征，D 正确。B 错在时间：金属玻璃等材料是“今天习以为常、40 年代象征未来”，不是“当时流行”；C 与 were smaller 相反；A 与 the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions 相反。

items.stem: What can we learn about the design of the "Case Study Houses"?
opts: Natural scenes were taken into consideration.
Details were sacrificed for the overall effect.
items.exp: 定位末段②句 Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing，landscape 即把自然景色纳入设计，B 正确。A 与 few American families acquired helicopters 相反；C 与 forthright detailing 相反；D 的“环保材料”是 today 视角的附会。

sections.title: Text 4　欧元区的分歧与前途
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：法德在“协调什么”上僵持，作者结尾仍看好欧盟。第 39 题守住 redistribution 的方向：富国→穷国。

paras.en: Will the European Union make it? The question would have sounded strange not long ago. Now even the project's greatest cheerleaders talk of a continent facing a "Bermuda triangle" of debt, population decline and lower growth.
paras.zh: 欧盟能撑过去吗？这个问题在不久以前听起来还会显得奇怪。如今，就连这个一体化方案最热烈的拥护者也在谈论欧洲大陆正面临由债务、人口下降和增长放缓组成的“百慕大三角”。

paras.en: As well as those chronic problems, the EU faces an acute crisis in its economic core, the 16 countries that use the single currency. Markets have lost faith that the euro zone's economies, weaker or stronger, will one day converge thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency, which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation.
paras.zh: 除了这些长期问题，欧盟在其经济核心——使用单一货币的 16 个国家——还面临一场急性危机。市场已经不再相信，欧元区各国的经济无论强弱，总有一天会因共用一种货币的纪律而趋同；这种纪律让缺乏竞争力的成员国无法用货币贬值来快速解困。

paras.en: Yet the debate about how to save Europe's single currency from disintegration is stuck. It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonisation within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonise.
paras.zh: 然而，关于如何挽救欧洲单一货币免于解体的辩论却卡住了。卡住的原因是，欧元区的主导力量法国和德国都认为需要在欧元区内加强协调，但对“协调什么”意见不一。

paras.en: Germany thinks the euro must be saved by stricter rules on borrowing, spending and competitiveness, backed by quasi-automatic sanctions for governments that do not obey. These might include threats to freeze EU funds for poorer regions and EU mega-projects, and even the suspension of a country's voting rights in EU ministerial councils. It insists that economic co-ordination should involve all 27 members of the EU club, among whom there is a small majority for free-market liberalism and economic rigour; in the inner core alone, Germany fears, a small majority favour French interference.
paras.zh: 德国认为，拯救欧元必须靠更严格的借贷、支出和竞争力规则，并以对不遵守规则的政府近乎自动的制裁为后盾。这些制裁可能包括威胁冻结面向较贫困地区和欧盟重大项目的资金，甚至暂停一国在欧盟部长理事会中的表决权。德国坚持认为，经济协调应涵盖欧盟全部 27 个成员国——其中支持自由市场主义和经济紧缩的仅占微弱多数；德国担心，仅在核心圈内，支持法国式干预的也占微弱多数。

paras.en: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members. Translated, that means politicians intervening in monetary policy and a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members, via cheaper borrowing for governments through common Eurobonds or complete fiscal transfers. Finally, figures close to the French government have murmured, euro-zone members should agree to some fiscal and social harmonisation: e.g., curbing competition in corporate-tax rates or labour costs.
paras.zh: 以法国为首的“南方”阵营想要另一套东西：在欧元区成员国的核心圈内建立“欧洲经济政府”。说白了，这意味着政治家干预货币政策，以及一套从富国向穷国再分配的制度——通过共同欧元债券或完全的财政转移，让各国政府以更低的成本借到钱。最后，与法国政府关系密切的人士私下嘀咕，欧元区成员国还应就某些财政和社会协调达成一致，例如抑制企业税率或劳动力成本方面的竞争。

paras.en: It is too soon to write off the EU. It remains the world's largest trading block. At its best, the European project is remarkably liberal: built around a single market of 27 rich and poor countries, its internal borders are far more open to goods, capital and labour than any comparable trading area. It is an ambitious attempt to blunt the sharpest edges of globalisation, and make capitalism benign.
paras.zh: 现在就断言欧盟不行了还为时过早。它仍是世界最大的贸易集团。在其最好的状态下，欧洲一体化方案相当开放：它围绕 27 个贫富国家的单一市场建立，内部边界对商品、资本和劳动力的开放程度超过任何可比的贸易区。它是一次雄心勃勃的尝试，意在磨平全球化最尖锐的棱角，让资本主义变得温和。

items.stem: The EU is faced with so many problems that
opts: it has more or less lost faith in markets
even its supporters begin to feel concerned
some of its member countries plan to abandon euro
it intends to deny the possibility of devaluation
items.exp: 定位第一段末句 even the project's greatest cheerleaders talk of a continent facing a Bermuda triangle of debt...。最坚定的拥护者也开始谈“百慕大三角”，说明连支持者都忧虑，B 正确。A 把 Markets have lost faith（市场对欧元区经济失去信心）偷换成“欧盟对市场失去信心”；C、D 文中无据。

items.stem: The debate over the EU's single currency is stuck because the dominant powers
opts: are competing for the leading position
are busy handling their own crises
fail to reach an agreement on harmonisation
disagree on the steps towards disintegration
items.exp: 定位第三段末句 agree on the need for greater harmonisation...but disagree about what to harmonise：两国都同意要协调，却谈不拢“协调什么”，C 是这一句的概括。A 的“争夺领导权”文中无据；D 把“如何避免解体”偷换成“解体的步骤”，方向完全错了。

items.stem: To solve the euro problem, Germany proposed that
opts: EU funds for poor regions be increased
only core members be involved in economic co-ordination
voting rights of the EU members be guaranteed
items.exp: 定位第四段首句 Germany thinks the euro must be saved by stricter rules on borrowing, spending and competitiveness，B 是 stricter rules 的同义改写。A 与“冻结对贫困地区资金”相反；C 与“协调应涵盖全部 27 国”相反；D 与“暂停表决权”相反。

items.stem: The French proposal of handling the crisis implies that
opts: poor countries are more likely to get funds
strict monetary policy will be applied to poor countries
loans will be readily available to rich countries
rich countries will basically control Eurobonds
items.exp: 定位第五段②句 a system of redistribution from richer to poorer members, via cheaper borrowing for governments，资金流向是从富国到穷国，故穷国更容易拿到钱，A 正确。C 把“穷国政府得以低成本借款”说成“富国”，方向相反；B 的紧缩货币政策是德国的主张；D 的“富国控制欧元债券”文中没有依据。

items.stem: Regarding the future of the EU, the author seems to feel
items.exp: 定位末段首句 It is too soon to write off the EU，随后又列举它是世界最大贸易集团、内部边界开放、意在让资本主义温和，字里行间是“仍有希望”，D 正确。A、B 与 too soon to write off 直接冲突；C 的 conceited 是作者可能用来批评欧盟的词，不是作者自身态度。

sections.title: Section II Part B　观点匹配（七选五）
sections.dir: Read the following text and answer the questions by finding information from the right column that corresponds to each of the marked details given in the left column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：资深医生要求政府对垃圾食品下狠手，卫生大臣却主张行业自律。五题各钉一段，两个多余项分别在“脂肪税”和“家长示范”上设陷。
subs: "fat taxes" should be imposed on fast-food producers such as McDonald's.
the government should ban fast-food outlets in the neighborhood of schools.
"lecturing" was an effective way to improve school lunches in England.
cigarette-style warnings should be introduced to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
the producers of crisps and candies could contribute significantly to the Change4Life campaign.
parents should set good examples for their children by keeping a healthy diet at home.
the government should strengthen the sense of responsibility among businesses.
sections.intro:
Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government's role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose "fat taxes" on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.

The demands follow comments made last week by the health secretary, Andrew Lansley, who insisted the government could not force people to make healthy choices and promised to free businesses from public health regulations.

But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald's. They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain's addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease. Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as smoking or excessive drinking.

"Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now. Are we willing to be just as courageous in respect of obesity? I would suggest that we should be," said the leader of the UK's children's doctors.

Lansley has alarmed health campaigners by suggesting he wants industry rather than government to take the lead. He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness. He has also criticised the celebrity chef Jamie Oliver's high-profile attempt to improve school lunches in England as an example of how "lecturing" people was not the best way to change their behaviour.

Stephenson suggested potential restrictions could include banning TV advertisements for foods high in fat, salt or sugar before 9 pm and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas. "If we were really bold, we might even begin to think of high-calorie fast food in the same way as cigarettes — by setting strict limits on advertising, product placement and sponsorship of sports events," he said.

Such a move could affect firms such as McDonald's, which sponsors the youth coaching scheme run by the Football Association. Fast-food chains should also stop offering "inducements" such as toys, cute animals and mobile phone credit to lure young customers, Stephenson said.

Professor Dinesh Bhugra, president of the Royal College of Psychiatrists, said: "If children are taught about the impact that food has on their growth, and that some things can harm, at least information is available up front."

He also urged councils to impose "fast-food-free zones" around schools and hospitals — areas within which takeaways cannot open.

A Department of Health spokesperson said: "We need to create a new vision for public health where all of society works together to get healthy and live longer. This includes creating a new 'responsibility deal' with business, built on social responsibility, not state regulation. Later this year, we will publish a white paper setting out exactly how we will achieve this."

The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.

blocks.exp: 定位第六段②句 He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign，play a central role 与 contribute significantly 同义，故选 E。A 的“脂肪税”是首段资深医生的主张，兰斯利恰恰反对政府管制、主张行业主导，属张冠李戴。
定位第四段末句与第五段：斯蒂芬森说垃圾食品之害“不亚于吸烟或过量饮酒”，又以禁烟令为例主张对肥胖“同样勇敢”，即支持向儿童发出香烟式警告，故选 D。G 是卫生部发言人的“责任协议”，C 是兰斯利批评的说法，都不是他的立场。

blocks.en: Jamie Oliver seemed to believe that
blocks.exp: 定位第六段末句：兰斯利把奥利弗改善英格兰校餐的高调努力当作例子，说明“说教”不是改变行为的好办法。既然被批评为“说教”，可见奥利弗相信说教有效，故选 C。注意这是兰斯利的转述，语气上是反讽，不能读成作者认同。

定位第十段 He also urged councils to impose “fast-food-free zones” around schools and hospitals — areas within which takeaways cannot open。学校周边禁止开快餐店，与 B 的 ban fast-food outlets in the neighborhood of schools 完全对应，故选 B。

blocks.en: A Department of Health spokesperson proposed that
blocks.zh: 卫生部的一位发言人提议
blocks.exp: 定位第十一段：发言人提出与商界建立新的“责任协议”，built on social responsibility, not state regulation，即强化企业的责任意识而非政府管制，故选 G。F 的“家长以身作则”全文从未出现，是与 A 并列的两个多余项，别被常识带偏。

sections.title: Section III　翻译
sections.dir: In this section there is a text in English. Translate it into Chinese. Write your translation on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
sections.note: 难点是 take a toll on（造成损害）与 volume（排放量）；air-conditioned 要落到“空调降温”。

paras.en: Who would have thought that, globally, the IT industry produces about the same volume of greenhouse gases as the world's airlines do — roughly 2 percent of all CO2 emissions?
paras.zh: 谁能想到，在全球范围内，IT 行业产生的温室气体总量竟与世界航空业大致相当——约占全部二氧化碳排放量的 2%？

paras.en: Many everyday tasks take a surprising toll on the environment. A Google search can leak between 0.2 and 7.0 grams of CO2, depending on how many attempts are needed to get the "right" answer. To deliver results to its users quickly, then, Google has to maintain vast data centres around the world, packed with powerful computers. While producing large quantities of CO2, these computers emit a great deal of heat, so the centres need to be well air-conditioned, which uses even more energy.
paras.zh: 许多日常事务对环境造成的损害出人意料。一次谷歌搜索可能排放 0.2 至 7.0 克二氧化碳，具体取决于要试多少次才能得到“正确”答案。因此，为了迅速把结果送达用户，谷歌必须在世界各地维护庞大的数据中心，里面装满高性能计算机。这些计算机在产生大量二氧化碳的同时，也散发出大量热量，因此数据中心需要良好的空调降温，而这又要消耗更多能源。

paras.en: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements. Monitoring is the first step on the road to reduction, but there is much more to be done, and not just by big companies.
paras.zh: 不过，谷歌和其他大型技术提供商都在密切监测自身的能效并加以改进。监测是减排之路的第一步，但要做的事还很多，而且不只是大公司的事。

words: 总量、排放量（此处不是“体积”）
有空调的、用空调降温的

sections.title: Section IV Part A　应用文（祝贺信 + 建议）
sections.dir: Suppose your cousin Li Ming has just been admitted to a university. Write him/her a letter to 1) congratulate him/her, and 2) give him/her suggestions on how to get prepared for university life. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Zhang Wei" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)
sections.note: 两个要点都要落地：先祝贺录取，再给 2—3 条具体准备建议（学业、生活、人际），别写成泛泛的“加油”。
sections.sample:
Dear Li Ming,

I was delighted to hear that you have been admitted to the university. Congratulations! All those late nights have finally paid off, and I am sure you will do well there.

Let me offer a few suggestions as you get ready. First, look through the course handbook and decide which subjects interest you most, so that you can plan your first term instead of drifting. Second, pick up a few practical skills before term starts — cooking, laundry and managing a monthly budget will save you a lot of trouble. Finally, join a club or a sports team in your first week, because friends made early make campus life far easier.

Do write and tell me how you get on.

Yours,
Zhang Wei
tips: 首段一句话完成“祝贺 + 点题”，congratulations 之后要落到被录取这件事上，不要只写 I am glad
建议至少两条且要具体：选课规划、生活自理、社团交友，比空喊 study hard 更能拿分
结尾一句期待回信即可，署名固定 Zhang Wei，不写地址、不写自己的真实姓名

sections.title: Section IV Part B　柱状图作文
sections.dir: Write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should 1) interpret the chart and 2) give your comments. You should write at least 150 words. Write your essay on ANSWER SHEET 2. (15 points)
sections.note: 柱状图：2008→2009 年国产车份额 25%→30%，日系 33%→23%，美系持平 10%。得分点在一升一降的对照与归因。
sections.sample:
The bar chart compares the market shares of domestic, Japanese and American brands in China's passenger car market in 2008 and 2009. Domestic brands rose from 25% to 30%, while Japanese brands fell sharply from 33% to 23%. American brands stayed almost unchanged at about 10%.

Two factors may explain the shift. First, domestic makers improved quality and design while keeping prices low, so more ordinary families chose them. Second, the global financial crisis hit Japanese and American producers hard: their parent companies cut production and promotion budgets in China, and some consumers began to prefer home-grown brands.

In my view, the trend will continue but at a slower pace. Domestic firms should invest more in core technology and after-sales service rather than compete on price alone, or the gain may prove short-lived.
tips: 第一段只读数：国产 25%→30%、日系 33%→23%、美系基本持平，三条都要写，且要说明单位是市场份额
第二段给两个原因（国产车性价比提升 + 金融危机冲击外资品牌），一内一外，最能拉开差距
第三段表态度：趋势会延续但会放缓，并给国产车企一句建议；不要另开新论点，一句收住
